zh.title: 芝加哥奧黑爾機場設備故障一度延誤到港航班　FAA 已解除地面管制
zh.summary: 芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場 11 月 24 日發生設備故障，美國聯邦航空總署一度要求部分飛往當地的航班暫留出發地，改採地面延誤計畫後於當天下午解除管制。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）11 月 24 日下午一度要求部分飛往芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場（ORD）的航班暫留出發地，並非暫停奧黑爾機場所有航班起飛。FAA 隨後改採地面延誤計畫，讓部分飛往奧黑爾的班機延後起飛。NBC Chicago 報導，該計畫在芝加哥當地時間下午 5 時前後已取消。
FAA 向芝加哥 ABC7 證實，設備故障期間確有部分航班延誤。ABC7 報導，當地時間約下午 6 時，延誤情況已明顯減輕。FAA 的機場狀態頁只提供整體情況，旅客應向航空公司確認個別航班。

en.title: FAA lifts ground restrictions at Chicago O’Hare after equipment outage delays arrivals
en.summary: The FAA temporarily held some Chicago O’Hare-bound flights at their departure airports on November 24 after an equipment outage, then switched to a ground delay program that it canceled the same afternoon.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration briefly held some flights bound for Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) at their departure airports on November 24. It did not halt all departures from O’Hare. The FAA then assigned later departure times to some inbound flights under a ground delay program. NBC Chicago reported the program was canceled by around 5 p.m. local time.

The FAA confirmed to Chicago’s ABC7 that some flights were delayed during the outage. ABC7 reported that delays had eased by about 6 p.m. local time. The FAA’s airport status page reports general conditions; passengers should check with their airline for individual flights.

facts.claim: The FAA lifted the ground stop for O’Hare-bound flights and then assigned later departure times under a ground delay program.
NBC Chicago reported that the ground delay program was canceled as of 5 p.m. Tuesday.
The FAA told ABC7 some flights were delayed during the equipment outage. Flights were still departing O’Hare during the stop, and ABC7 reported that delays were minimal by about 6 p.m.
The FAA airport status page lists general conditions and recommends checking with the airline for flight-specific information.
NBC Chicago originally published this event at 21:35:37 UTC on November 24.
